content:
Earlier this month, OpenAI released its first GPT-6 model paired with Astra. The GPT-6 series continues to expand with the official launch of the GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna models.

GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are available starting today

According to the release notes for the ChatGPT desktop app, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna consume fewer tokens than comparable GPT-5.6 models.

GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are rolling out on Codex and ChatGPT Work, with token pricing also lower than the previous GPT-5.6 version. Sol is suited for complex coding and agentic workflows, while Luna is suited for focused, high-throughput tasks. Both models will be made available progressively to Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users. Free and Go users can use Luna on the desktop app. Actual availability will depend on deployment progress and workspace settings; Enterprise admins will need to enable the new models themselves. Within ChatGPT, the two models are available only on Work and Codex, and have not been listed on Chat.

It is worth noting that there is no such thing as a GPT-6 Terra model. It appears that OpenAI is gradually phasing out mid-sized models, keeping only three: Terra (small), Sol (large), and Astra (extra-large).

Below is OpenAI's official announcement:

Even though the toughest and most important tasks still require the full depth of Astra, different jobs come with different scales, rhythms, and budgets. That is exactly why we are extending the GPT-6 family with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. GPT-6 Astra opened a new generation of intelligence, and these models push the value proposition even further, bringing the benefits to a broader range of users. We trained GPT-6 Sol and Luna using the same approach we used for GPT-6 Astra, distilling Astra's leading capabilities in professional work, factual accuracy, coding, computer use, and alignment into faster, more affordable models.

The company described the two newest models as outperforming the GPT-5.6 version, while also being priced lower than Astra (and the GPT-5.6 version it replaces). For example, the GPT-6 versions of Sol and Luna are priced 50% lower than the GPT-5.6 versions.
